verdict.rationale: Deprecation policy is a fair question for any model provider, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documented retirement policy, advance-notice commitment, or migration guide for retired models. The note that Llama 3.1 can serve as 'a drop-in replacement' is version-upgrade messaging, not a deprecation policy, so it is adjacent at best.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on a documented deprecation policy with advance notice and migration guidance before a model I depend on is retired
